extension.description: Toggle the visibility of dotfiles and other excluded files.

configuration.keepVisible.description: Dotfile names that remain visible when other dotfiles are hidden, for example `.env` and `.vscode`. The extension automatically handles the common `**/.*` catch-all rule. The legacy `**/.name` form is also accepted.
